passive.name: Determination
passive.text: Every third attack deals bonus damage and heals Xin Zhao.

spells.name: Three Talon Strike
spells.text: Xin Zhao's next 3 standard attacks deal increased damage with the third attack knocking an opponent into the air.

spells.name: Wind Becomes Lightning
spells.text: Xin Zhao slashes in front of himself with his spear, then thrusts it forward, slowing affected enemies and marking them as Challenged.

spells.name: Audacious Charge
spells.text: Xin Zhao charges to an enemy, gaining increased Attack Speed and dealing damage to all enemies in the area, slowing them briefly. This Ability gains increased range against Challenged targets.

spells.name: Crescent Guard
spells.text: Xin Zhao passively challenges an enemy he damaged recently. When activated, Xin Zhao deals damage to nearby enemies based on their current Health and knocks non-challenged targets back, becoming impervious to damage dealt by champions outside of the circle created.

damage.value: Xin Zhao deals sustained standard-attack damage through his passive and Q, with additional damage from W, E, and R.

archetype.value: Xin Zhao plays as an engage bruiser, charging into range for repeated attacks and crowd control.

axis.value: Xin Zhao can gank by approaching from behind, using Q first and saving E to follow a Flash.

spikes.why: Xin Zhao has all three basic abilities and can look for aggressive plays.
Xin Zhao can again empower three attacks and knock an enemy airborne with the third.

bait.why: Xin Zhao loses access to its bonus attack damage and third-hit knockup while Q is on cooldown.

mistakes.value: Xin Zhao loses health and time on camps when he neglects kiting.
Xin Zhao risks a bad objective contest if he spends Crescent Guard before he needs to secure the objective or disrupt an approach.
